name: Gakushoku no Oba-san ~Kaa-san no Shiru no Aji~
original_name: 学食のおばさん～母さんの汁の味～
source:
Daisuke is a university student. Though his parents went missing when he was a kid, he enjoys his school life. One day, he becomes friends with two women. One of them is Kumi, his classmate. She is thirty years old and married. The other is Ryoko. She works at a school canteen. It doesn't take long until he and Ryoko fall in love and they finally sleep together.... One day, he tells her about his past. And her face suddenly turns pale and she says, "I can't meet you anymore...." Actually, Ryoko is his own mother....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090117045215/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1008902]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
大輔是一名大學生。雖然父母在他年幼時便已失蹤，他仍然享受著校園生活。一天，他與兩名女性成為朋友。其中一人是同學久美，她今年30歲，已經結婚了。另一人是學生餐廳的工作人員涼子。不久，大輔與涼子墜入愛河，最終發生了關係……一天，他向涼子講述自己的過去。涼子的臉色突然變得蒼白，說道：「我不能再見你了……」原來，涼子正是他的親生母親……

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090117045215/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1008902]ErogeShop[/url]]
